transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... mostly my wife told me I should come in. She... she says it's just regular talk. But I know what I'm hearing. 

Down at the domino table, the men there... they slip in these little messages. Just meant for me. Sometimes the fella on the radio does it, too. They're... well, they're warning me to be careful. My wife don't believe it, but... I know a warning when I hear one. That's all.
How long have you been noticing these messages from the radio and the men at the domino table?
Well... been a while, I suppose. Maybe... oh, about nine months or so. It ain't every single day. Just... on and off.
Have you experienced any long periods where your mood was extremely low or, conversely, where you felt unusually high, energetic, or invincible?

Well... I wouldn't use a word like invincible. But... I suppose there's weeks where I wake up feeling real bright. Important, I guess. 

I reckon I talk a lot faster then. Laugh louder than usual. But... if folks try to slow me down, or start questioning what I'm doing... I get sharp with 'em. Just... lose my patience, is all. Don't mean much more than that.
During those weeks when you felt 'bright' and energetic, did the messages from the radio and the men at the domino table stop, or were they still happening?

Well... they don't stop. Even when I'm having those bright weeks... when I ain't sleeping much and I got all these big plans in my head... I still hear 'em. 

My friend's voice... the radio... the fellas at the table. They're still sending those warnings. Just... always there, I guess.

Aside from those 'bright' weeks, have you ever gone through periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt so down or hopeless that you lost interest in almost everything or couldn't function in your daily life?

No... I don't think so. I mean, sure, I get a little blue sometimes, like anybody else my age. But... not like you're saying. I still get up. Still do what I need to do. Just... normal tired, I guess. Nothing... nothing hopeless.

During those 'bright' weeks when you felt energetic and had big plans, were there times when you were so active or excited that it caused serious problems with your work, your marriage, or led to you being hospitalized?

Well... no, no hospitals. And I ain't worked in a long time, so... no. 

I suppose... well, I have missed a few choir rehearsals when I get like that. And... I let parts of my garden go, I guess. Just got other things on my mind. 

As for the domino games... I don't join in like I used to. Reckon I made it a bit uncomfortable for 'em. But... it ain't nothing too serious. Just... how it goes sometimes.
During those 'bright' weeks, did you feel like you were so energetic or talkative that other people noticed you were acting quite differently than your usual self?

I reckon folks might notice. Sometimes I just wake up feeling... well, real bright. Like I got important things going on. I suppose I might talk a bit fast, or laugh louder than usual. 

But... if somebody tries to slow me down, or asks too many questions about what I'm doing... I get a little sharp with 'em. Just... don't like being bothered when I'm like that.
During those 'bright' weeks, did you feel like you had so much energy and needed so little sleep that you could go for several days with almost no sleep at all and still feel perfectly refreshed?

Well... yeah, I suppose so. On them nights, I might only sleep... maybe two, three hours. Then I'm up before the sun. Don't feel tired neither. Just... ready to get to work, like I slept the whole night through.
Have there been times when you were hearing these messages for at least two weeks, but you were NOT feeling those 'bright' or energetic feelings?

Well... yeah. There was a spell... maybe a whole month where things were just quiet. 

I was sleeping regular again... wasn't getting worked up over no big plans. But... I still heard my friend out on the porch. And... well, the radio was still speaking to me. So... yeah, I suppose so.
Aside from the messages you hear, have people ever mentioned that your speech is difficult to follow, or that your behavior seems disorganized or hard for them to understand?

Well... I don't know about all that. But... sometimes when I go down to play dominoes with the fellas... 

I guess I do some things they don't get. I'll just... tap the tiles, you know? Same way, over and over. And... I might hold my hand up, like I'm telling cars to stop. They tell me to just play the game, but... I just do it. Don't really know why.

Has the way you've been acting or these messages you hear caused you to lose your job, get into major trouble with the law, or led to a complete breakdown in your relationships with your family or friends?

Well... no. Ain't no police or nothing like that. I don't work no more anyway, so there's no job to lose. 

I just... I suppose I miss choir practice sometimes now. And... I let some of my garden go. Just weeds in parts of it. As for the fellas... I guess I made the domino games a bit uncomfortable for 'em. So... I just don't go down and join 'em like I used to. That's about all.

Looking back over the entire nine months, would you say that you spent more time experiencing those 'bright' energetic weeks, or more time feeling like your usual self while still hearing those messages?

Well... I suppose... if you look at the whole time... it's mostly been those high-energy spells. 

Them and... well, the time it takes to settle down after. That's taken up more months than the quiet times. So... yeah. Mostly the bright spells.
